title: Us Against You
author: Fredrik Backman
review:
This builds off the first book in the best ways. Some great characters and hard hitting moments. These aren't really standalone and feel like they should be read close together. Really love the town dynamics and the characters get even more depth here.

Backman has some great writing and the themes and foreshadowing kept me really engaged. Felt like I binged this one and had to know what was going to happen.

Much pain, highly recommend.

highlights.text: And the sun rises. Tomorrow, again.
Because it’s a simple game if you strip away all the crap surrounding it and just keep the things that made us love it in the first place. Everyone gets a stick. Two nets. Two teams. Us against you.
